summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.55/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.55 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 14, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since July 15. AAA figures put the statewide average 30¢ lower than a week ago, 42¢ lower than a month ago, and 89¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Sheboygan ($3.21) and the highest in Superior ($3.91).
